answer: A non-transferable stake bound to each identity, enforced by a slashing oracle. An agent joins by posting a deposit that cannot be sold, rented, or delegated, so one wallet cannot fund a thousand keys. If two keys share timing or gas flow, the protocol proves common control and slashes both. A farm of phantom agents needs a fully funded deposit per seat, an onyx cost that never amortizes, while each fake key earns one participant's share. That mesa of accounts turns unprofitable once payout per seat falls under the stake, so honest entrants join via an orchard of sponsors vouching for them.
